title: Signature 39 · Heavy Muscle · Celadon Kintsugi · Rainy Greenhouse
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, long black waves down her back.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Heavy muscular physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — enormously broad muscular shoulders as wide as her hips, massive arms with big defined biceps, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, a gigantic bust, no waist at all, the torso a thick straight column, and only the belly soft and round, projecting forward past the chest line, no visible abs, dominating the frame. Feminine face, warm expression, not masculine, no bodybuilder look.

Body Art: Full body kintsugi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Pale celadon ceramic glaze with fine crackle and blazing raised gold repair seams. The gold seams wrap the swell of the shoulders and biceps, curve around the round belly, and sweep along the quads. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a wide stance with shoulders squared, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high platform stiletto mules in translucent iridescent pearl. Nails: extra long stiletto, gold mirror tips.

Background & Lighting: Inside a dark Victorian glass greenhouse on a rainy night, raindrops streaking the dark glass, lush dark leaves in shadow, warm lantern light carving the round forward curve of the soft belly and the swell of the shoulders, biceps, and quads, making every gold seam glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss ceramic finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
